```{r Data Preprocessing}
library(disdat)
library(mgcv)
library(sf)

library(fields)

library(glmnet)
library(scampr)
#install.packages("glmmTMB_1.1.9-9000.tar.gz",  repos = NULL, type = "source")
library(glmmTMB)
set.seed(0)

# get the data
source("get_and_format_flora_data.R")
rm(dat_pa)

# get the relevant predictors according to pred_set (these are all basically derived from elevation, we are just looking at moisture and temp. covars and soil fertility score and disturbance index)
# preds <- switch(pred_set,
#                 A = "None",
#                 B = c("mi", "tempann"),
#                 C = c("mi", "tempann", "mi2", "tempann2"),
# )

# get a vector of the factor terms
facts <- c("disturb", "soilfert", "vegsis")

# load the species information
load("flora_species.RDATA")

# get the groups to which the flora species belongs to subset the data
flora_groups <- unique(sp.info$group)

# subset the presence-only data (in the case we are using restricted species)
pres <- pres[pres$group %in% flora_groups, ]

# want to use species with at least 10 presences
pres <- pres[pres$spid %in% names(table(pres$spid))[table(pres$spid) >= 10], ]

# get the species
species <- unique(pres$spid)

# assign some numbers
m <- length(species) # responses
q <- nrow(quad) # quadrature points

# add in the quadrature for each species (replicates of the supplied background points)
tmp <- quad[rep(seq_len(q), m), ]
tmp$spid <- rep(species, each = q) # assign the species id's
dat <- rbind(pres, tmp)
n <- nrow(dat)
rm(tmp)

# set the coordinates to x and y so we can just use default labels
dat$lon <- dat$x; dat$lat <- dat$y; dat$x <- dat$xm; dat$y <- dat$ym; dat$xm <- NULL; dat$ym <- NULL

load("domain.RDATA")
domain$lon <- domain$x; domain$lat <- domain$y; domain$x <- domain$xm; domain$y <- domain$ym; domain$xm <- NULL; domain$ym <- NULL

gc()
```

```{r Build spatial basis functions}
bfs <- make_basis(k = 50, domain, from.package = "scampr")

# need to prune in the case of scampr bfs
if (is(bfs, "scampr.bf")) {
  tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, rbind(pres[,c("xm", "ym")], quad[,c("xm", "ym")])) # via the data?
  # tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, pres[,c("xm", "ym")]) # via the data?
  bf.check <- apply(tmp, 2, function(x){sum(x > 0)})
  bfs <- bfs[bf.check != 0, ]
  rm(tmp, bf.check)
}

#evaluate basis functions at every data point
#Z_star = bf_matrix(bfs, dat[, c("x", "y")])
#Z_star = Z_star/max(apply(Z_star,2,sd)) #some standardisation needed for ridge fits
#save(Z_star, file = "Z_star.RDATA")
load("Z_star.RDATA")

```



```{r Fitting - alternating column/row updates (single latent spatial factor}

#initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

# Rename spid
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))

attach(dat_rename)
Zu = Z_star%*%u

chosen_spid = unique(spid)
n_species = length(chosen_spid)

X_full = cbind(1, mi, tempann)

beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = n_species, ncol = ncol(Zu) + ncol(X_full))

rows_by_species = split(seq_len(nrow(dat_rename)), spid)
species_idx_row = match(spid, chosen_spid) #543323 x 1

N = 1000 
loglik = -Inf
max_it = 3

time_i = system.time({for (iter in 1:N){
  X_Zu = cbind(X_full, Zu)

  for (j in seq_along(chosen_spid)){
    i = chosen_spid[j]
    idx = rows_by_species[[as.character(i)]]
    
    X_i = X_Zu[idx, ]
    
    start_iter = if (all(is.finite(beta_lambda[j, ]))) {
      beta_lambda[j, ]
      } else {
        NULL
        }

    glm1 = glm.fit(y = occ[idx]/wt[idx], x = as.matrix(X_i), family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = wt[idx], intercept = TRUE, start = start_iter, control = glm.control(maxit = max_it))
    
    # store this species' intercept + beta + lambda (1 loading)
    beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glm1$coefficients))  
  }

  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)] #54 x 4
  lambda = as.matrix(beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)])
  
  lambda_rep = lambda[species_idx_row, , drop = TRUE]

  offset = rowSums(X_full * beta[species_idx_row, , drop = FALSE])

  Zl_joint = Z_star * lambda_rep 

  start_iter_u = if (all(is.finite(u))) {
    u} else {
      NULL
      }

  glm1 = glm.fit(x = Zl_joint, y = occ/wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = wt, offset = as.numeric(offset), start = start_iter_u, control = glm.control(maxit = max_it))
  
  u = as.numeric(glm1$coefficients)
  print(u)
  
  #rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  Zu = Z_star%*%u
  eta = offset + rowSums(Zu * lambda_rep)
  #eta = offset + (Z_star * lambda_rep) %*% u
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_mglm = mu
  
  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_mglm = sum(occ * log(mu) - wt * mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_mglm, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if (is.finite(loglik) && abs(loglik_new_mglm - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new_mglm)) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_mglm}
})
save(loglik_new_mglm, file = "loglik_new_mglm.RDATA")

time_mglm = as.numeric(time_i[3])
time_mglm
save(time_mglm, file = "time_mglm.RDATA")
```

```{r Inhomogeneous K functions Error : vector memory limit of 16.0 Gb reached, see mem.maxVSize() retrying}
# Diagnostic for chosen species, target_species_id
# Calculate observed, simulated inhomogeneous K functions

# Species-specific loading
lambda_j = lambda[j, ]

# Latent spatial coefficients
u_sim = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

# Simulated spatial field for this species
spatial_sim = Z_domain_star%*%u_sim %*% lambda_j

# Fixed + spatial component
eta_sim <- X_domain %*% beta[j, ] + spatial_sim

# Point process intensity
intensity_sim = exp(eta_sim)
domain$intensity = as.numeric(intensity_sim)

# Build observation window in same coordinate system used throughout
border_xy = st_transform(border_lonlat, crs = 28356)
# Convert projected coordinates to kilometres to match domain$x/y/xm/ym
border_geom = st_union(st_geometry(border_xy)) / 1000
# Remove CRS metadata for spatstat
st_crs(border_geom) = NA
win = as.owin(st_sf(geometry = border_geom))

# Convert fixed-effect log-intensity surface and full fitted intensity surface into spatstat pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain[, c("x","y","intensity")], W = win)

# Rename pres_df's spid to match dat_rename's convention, then subset to just this species' own presence locations
pres_df_rename = pres %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
sp_presence_df = pres_df_rename[pres_df_rename$spid == target_species_id, ]

# Build species' point pattern within study window using same kilometre-scale as win
po_sp_ppp = ppp(x = sp_presence_df$xm,
                y = sp_presence_df$ym,
                window = win)

# Observed inhomogeneous K-function for this species, using its fitted intensity surface
glm_m_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border")
# 'correction' To capture possible neighbouring points outside the window
# Simulate comparison point patterns from a Matern log-Gaussian Cox process and construct simulation envelope
glm_m_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rpoispp(pred.im)))

# Plot observed K-function and simulation envelope
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
Kfunc(glm_m_K_obs, glm_m_K_env)
glm_m_kfunc = recordPlot()
save(glm_m_kfunc, file = "glm_m_kfunc.RDATA")

load("glm_m_kfunc.RDATA")
replayPlot(glm_m_kfunc)
```

```{r Inhomogeneous K functions vector memory limit, 113641 out of 587016 terms (19.4%) in FFT calculation of matrix square root were negative, and were set to zero}
# Diagnostic for chosen species, target_species_id
# Calculate observed, simulated inhomogeneous K functions

# Species-specific loading
lambda_j = lambda[j, ]

# Variance of shared latent spatial field coefficients u, common across all basis functions, ridge penalty -> precision
var_u = 1

# Per-basis-function variance
vars <- rep(var_u, ncol(Z_star))

# Propagate coefficient variance through basis functions at every grid location - Var(sum_k Z_k(s) * u_k * lambda_jk) = sum_k [Z_k(s) * lambda_jk]^2 * Var(u_k)
var_smooth_grid <- drop((Z_domain_star * lambda_j)^2 %*% vars)

# Average propagated variance/spatil variance over prediction grid
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)

# This species' fixed-effect linear predictor - used as mean
domain$mean = drop(X_domain %*% beta[j, ])

domain$intensity = exp(domain$log_intensity)

# Build observation window in same coordinate system used throughout
border_xy = st_transform(border_lonlat, crs = 28356)
# Convert projected coordinates to kilometres to match domain$x/y/xm/ym
border_geom = st_union(st_geometry(border_xy)) / 1000
# Remove CRS metadata for spatstat
st_crs(border_geom) = NA
win = as.owin(st_sf(geometry = border_geom))

# Convert fixed-effect log-intensity surface and full fitted intensity surface into spatstat pixel images
fixed.im = as.im(domain[, c("x", "y", "mean")], W = win)
pred.im = as.im(domain[, c("x","y","intensity")], W = win)

# Rename pres_df's spid to match dat_rename's convention, then subset to just this species' own presence locations
pres_df_rename = pres %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
sp_presence_df = pres_df_rename[pres_df_rename$spid == target_species_id, ]

# Build species' point pattern within study window using same kilometre-scale as win
po_sp_ppp = ppp(x = sp_presence_df$xm,
                y = sp_presence_df$ym,
                window = win)

#load("opt.RDATA")

# Observed inhomogeneous K-function for this species, using its fitted intensity surface
glm_m_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border")

# Simulate comparison point patterns from a Matern log-Gaussian Cox process and construct simulation envelope
glm_m_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = bfs$scale[1])))

# Plot observed K-function and simulation envelope
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
Kfunc(glm_m_K_obs, glm_m_K_env)
glm_m_kfunc = recordPlot()
```
